stories.headline: The European Central Bank raises its rates by a quarter point
stories.summary: The European Central Bank lifted all three of its key interest rates by 0.25 percentage points on Thursday, taking the deposit rate to 2.50%. It pointed to higher energy prices adding to inflation across the eurozone.

stories.headline: August ties for the hottest month ever recorded
stories.summary: The EU's Copernicus Climate Change Service says August 2026 tied with July 2023 as the hottest month in its records, which go back to 1940. The global surface air temperature averaged 62.53 degrees Fahrenheit, almost 3 degrees above pre-industrial levels.

stories.headline: Kissing, cockroach milk and nose-blowing win Ig Nobel Prizes
stories.summary: The Ig Nobel Prizes, the parody awards for research that makes people laugh and then think, were announced on 3 September at the 36th annual ceremony. Winners in the ten categories included a precise scientific definition of kissing, a study of cockroach milk proteins and a 1977 paper on the aerodynamics of nose-blowing.

stories.headline: An 11,000-year-old statue of a person riding a leopard
stories.summary: Archaeologists at Karahan Tepe in Turkey have unearthed a Neolithic sculpture of a human riding on the back of a leopard. The 2.3-foot-tall statue, about 11,000 years old, stood on a platform in a round structure nearly ten feet across, and Turkey's culture minister says it has no known parallel.
